faq.q: Is Holly an official City of Delta planning area?
faq.a: This file does not treat it as one. Holly is the MLS sub-area name on the live page; the governing plan is the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400 — a single consolidated plan with land-use designations in its Land Use Plan (s. 1.5) and no area-plan schedule for this part of Ladner.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Holly?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Holly is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
